title: Quick,Energizing Middle-Eastern Greens Tabbouleh
description: A crisp, energizing middle-eastern salad made with parsley, mint, and bulgur, served in a cataplana. This dish is perfect for a quick lunch or snack.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.notes: Fresh parsley is a must for this tabbouleh.

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.notes: Add a few sprigs of fresh mint for flavor and zest.

ingredients.name: Bulgur
ingredients.notes: Use fine-grained bulgur for a quicker cooking time.

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.notes: Melt the ghee in the cataplana before adding the bulgur.

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice to the salad.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic and mix with the parsley and mint.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Season the salad with salt and pepper to taste.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a few grinds of black pepper for extra flavor.

instructions: Combine bulgur, ghee, and a pinch of salt in a sous-vide water bath at 18030F for 30 minutes.
Drain the bulgur and let it cool to room temperature.
Chop the parsley and mint and mix with the cooled bulgur.
Add the lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tabbouleh in a cataplana, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
